analysis.overview: The frames largely cover separate life domains. Their shared ground concerns variable holiday service hours, while errand-combining experiences differ meaningfully according to branch geography and advance checks. The reference spans extensive personal routines and constraints; the compared frame adds return-shipping procedures.
